Subject: Security & Compliance architecture review – SOC 2 evidence, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week – the team was impressed with the performance and cost numbers. Our security team would like to do a focused architecture & compliance review before we move forward with the pilot. High-level ask: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive to cover SOC 2 evidence mapping, encryption (at-rest + in-transit), audit/logging architecture, and SSO/integration requirements.

Proposed attendees from our side: myself, Nicole Tran (Security Lead), and one engineer from infra. Could you include the folks from your side who can speak to SOC 2 controls and the runtime encryption/KMS story?

Availability: Wed Apr 2 or Thu Apr 3 – morning or early afternoon PT preferred.

Would also appreciate any pre-read (SOC 2 checklist, architecture diagram) you can share. We may have a couple of procurement questions about contract language and data processing (I'll loop the procurement person if needed).

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Security, MedTech.io
phone: +1 415-555-0192

I can host and we'll have Dev Patel (infrastructure lead) and Laura Bennett (security/compliance PM) join to cover SOC 2 evidence and runtime details.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Apr 2, 10:00–11:30

If those don't work we can move to Fri.

Attached: Agenda-Security-Compliance-DeepDive.pdf (draft) and a SOC2-evidence-checklist.xlsx – these are pre-reads that map Redwood controls to typical SOC 2 criteria. Can you confirm your SSO provider (Okta/OneLogin/Custom SAML) and whether we should prepare KMS/HSM details? Also let us know expected log retention windows and any specific audit exports you need.

If you want, loop whoever will sign the contract so we can have Rishi (sales) on the call for any commercial/contract questions.
